## Beta build: for testing

This is a **test version**. It's here for reviewers and testers before it replaces the current release.

### What's new in 1.1
- **Three tiers of 500 words each:** Beginner, Expert and Master (1,500 words in total), ordered from most to least common.
- **Sets of ten.** Every tier is split into 50 sets in a suggested order, and you can open any set you like. Learning all ten words of a set earns a bonus. Remembering them over the following days earns a gold star.
- **Placement quiz.** A short quiz suggests where to start, so experienced players can skip what they already know.
- **Hover definitions.** Point at any synonym or antonym to see what it means.
- **Players.** Several people can share one computer, each with their own progress.
- **Review.** Words come back at growing intervals, and a Review screen shows what's due.

Your existing progress carries over automatically. Every word you've learned is kept, and a backup of the old save file is made the first time 1.1 opens.

### Download

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| **VocabQuest-Setup-x.y.z.exe** | Installer. Installs over the current version and keeps your progress. |
| **VocabQuest-Portable-x.y.z.exe** | Runs without installing. |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums for verifying the download. |

The app is not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

### Feedback

Please open an issue on the repository with anything that looks wrong, especially definitions, synonyms or antonyms that seem off.
